items.title: The long view in construction
items.excerpt: Civic building is measured in decades, not quarters. A note on why the group still specifies for the second generation of a structure's users rather than the first.

items.title: Steady passage
items.excerpt: Bulk and liquid cargo move on relationships as much as on routes. How the shipping arm thinks about reliability when conditions at sea and in the market rarely agree.

items.title: What outlasts the ledger
items.excerpt: The institutions the group supports are not a line item. A short reflection on stewardship, and on the buildings that keep working long after the ribbon is cut.
